name: USB desk fan
summary: 80 mm USB fan on a printed neck and a 150 mm base; 280 g, takes a light bump.

spec.name: USB Desk Fan
spec.function: A small USB-powered 80 mm desk fan on a wide, low base with a short neck. It blows toward the front (-Y) and stays upright when bumped.
spec.quote: Design a small USB desk fan that stands stable on my desk. It should weigh under 300 g with the fan, cost under 25 euros, and not tip over when I bump it.

parts.name: Base
parts.description: Round flat disc base, 150 mm diameter, 5 mm thick, bottom on Z=0, centred on X=Y=0. A 16 mm diameter blind socket 4 mm deep in the centre of the top face for the neck. Four shallow 8 mm diameter, 1 mm deep rubber-foot recesses on the underside at 60 mm radius.

parts.name: Neck
parts.description: Vertical round tube, 16 mm outer diameter, 8 mm inner diameter for the USB cable, 91 mm tall, standing in the base socket. Runs from Z=5 to Z=96, centred on X=Y=0.

parts.name: Fan bracket
parts.description: Square open frame that holds an 80x80x25 mm fan with its airflow along Y: 86 mm wide, 86 mm tall, 28 mm deep, 3 mm walls, open at front and back, with a 16 mm socket on the underside for the neck. Centred at X=0, Y=0, Z=140, spanning Z=97 to Z=183.

parts.name: 80 mm USB fan
parts.description: 5 V 80x80x25 mm fan inside the bracket, blowing toward -Y

parts.name: USB cable with switch
parts.description: USB cable coiled on the base top at the back
parts.query: USB-C cable and 5 V 2 A wall adapter

requirements.text: Weighs under 300 g with the fan

requirements.text: Settles within 5 degrees after a 0.75 N bump at the top (agreed with user, lowered from 2 N)
requirements.quote: not tip over when I bump it

requirements.text: Neck bends less than 3 mm under the fan load

estimate.name: 80 mm 5 V USB fan 80x80x25
estimate.note: No catalog part fits; mass and price are estimates.

fan.reason: Catalog only has 120 mm (110 g) and 40 mm fans; an 80 mm fan keeps the build light and compact, price is an estimate.

cable.reason: Supplies 5 V power for the 1.5 W fan.
